items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: you had white disc jockeys like Symphony Sid, uh, coming out of New York

ctx.x: What about, uh, what about the, like, Miles Davis?

Yeah, the Miles Davis, yeah. The Miles Davis. The Dizzy Gillespie. The Dizzy Gillespie. The Dizzy Gillespie. I played, I played all of that that way. And then, uh, you know, I was more into a jazz blues kind of thing there for a while, because Eddie Cleanhead Benson had come out with some tunes, because he came out of, uh, trying to think, uh, what band, he came out of the band with, uh, Cootie Williams. He came out of Cootie Williams' band. See? Now, uh, he, he was born in Houston, Texas. And it just so happened…
